note: The full requirement list implied by the project brief, with acceptance criteria and where each is actually satisfied. Status vocabulary: Delivered = implemented and verified this session; Partial = implemented with a stated gap; Blocked = needs a source or an owner decision that does not exist yet; Deferred = deliberately out of scope for v1.

requirements.requirement: Collect NFL data into one organised place
requirements.acceptance: one directory, dated files, one builder, no hand-keyed duplicates
requirements.where: hub/data/ + scripts/build_hub.py; legacy copies remain in data/, docs/data/, dashboard/data/, x3lab/data/
requirements.note: Consolidation of the older directories is S-01/S-03, an owner decision

requirements.requirement: Analyse against a full list of requirements
requirements.acceptance: this register exists, is row-by-row and states status with evidence

requirements.requirement: Suggestions to improve the site and decision-making
requirements.acceptance: each suggestion has an evidenced problem, options, impact, effort, risk and a recommendation
requirements.note: 20 suggestions

requirements.requirement: A dedicated section to review suggestions and choose a path before implementing
requirements.acceptance: queue exists, statuses separate Done/Proposed, nothing analytical changed without a decision
requirements.note: 7 items were implemented in the hub only to demonstrate the mechanism; 13 await a decision

requirements.requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers to address before decisions
requirements.acceptance: open questions with known/missing/discovery path/owner/blocking, plus answered questions with sources
requirements.note: 18 open (10 blocking) and 10 answered

requirements.requirement: Suggestions to discover missing information
requirements.acceptance: a gap register naming each missing input, why it is missing and how to obtain it

requirements.requirement: Originate our own NFL lines
requirements.acceptance: a published number per unplayed game, computed only from official inputs, with formula and parameters printed
requirements.note: grading is blocked by G-04 / no price source

requirements.requirement: Research and develop strategies for useful signals
requirements.acceptance: signal catalog with input, construction, direction, target and dependency on a gate
requirements.note: 12 signals; 6 computed, 6 blocked for data that does not exist yet

requirements.requirement: Leaderboard competition that rewards top-performing strategies
requirements.acceptance: scoring model, season structure, anti-gaming rules, reward tiers, and an empty table until gates pass
requirements.note: reward amounts blank pending Q-08 (FLG-14)

requirements.requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop combinations
requirements.acceptance: each bet type has a construction and its own blocking gates
requirements.note: ST-01..ST-08: 5 singles/prop, 1 combo, 1 parlay rule, 1 ensemble

requirements.requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates
requirements.acceptance: gates defined, each strategy mapped to the gates it fails, no promotion without all blockers passed
requirements.note: 11 gates, 0 strategies qualified

requirements.requirement: Determine correlation values
requirements.acceptance: a register where each pair is either computed with method and n, or blank with the exact data that would compute it
requirements.note: 5 computed from official standings; 7 blank pending game logs and prices

requirements.requirement: Remove luck; build selectively skill-based strategies
requirements.acceptance: pre-registration, out-of-sample grading, CLV primacy, DSR/PBO corrections, uncertainty intervals
requirements.note: luck cannot be removed, only bounded and measured - stated on the page

requirements.requirement: Track injuries
requirements.acceptance: full official report for the slate, transcribed row by row, with as-of stamp and a diff against the previous snapshot
requirements.note: 345 rows, 28 clubs, all statuses verified

requirements.requirement: Know defensive deficiencies, including 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replacing starters
requirements.acceptance: certified layer = which starters are unavailable; string layer = only if an official source states it
requirements.note: string ranks are blank because no official depth chart exists (FLG-08)

requirements.requirement: Same for offenses using starters or backups
requirements.acceptance: offensive-side availability loss per club and per position group, feeding the model adjustment
requirements.note: as R-15; QB-starter identity resolved only where an official news page states it

requirements.requirement: Executive summary of important details
requirements.acceptance: one page: what is verified, what is missing, what is decided next
requirements.note: every count on it is computed at build time

requirements.requirement: No manual input from the owner during the session
requirements.acceptance: all data fetched, transcribed, verified and published autonomously; open items framed as decisions with recommendations, not questions back to the owner mid-session

requirements.requirement: Review the repo line by line with links for manual review, flag irregularities
requirements.acceptance: repo audit page with per-item links and flags carrying evidence URLs
requirements.note: 20 flags; 1 error in a prior tree found (FLG-18)

requirements.requirement: Every table row has an official source link; unconfirmable values blank and flagged; never infer
requirements.acceptance: enforced by a machine gate at build time, not by convention
requirements.note: rows failing the rule abort the build

requirements.requirement: GitHub Pages site: clean landing page and subpages by category, dashboard-like tables
requirements.acceptance: landing + 15 category pages, one stylesheet, no build tooling needed to read

requirements.requirement: Season-long / futures origination
requirements.acceptance: not attempted in v1
requirements.note: 9 weeks of data; a futures model would mostly measure noise

requirements.requirement: Parallel-session coordination with a shared board, claims and non-overlapping scopes
requirements.acceptance: COORDINATION.md updated with a claim before work, sources and verification recorded when done
requirements.note: scope respected: no other session's file edited

requirements.requirement: PR to main, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploy
requirements.acceptance: PR link, merge commit, Pages status, live URL checks recorded

requirements.requirement: Site builds with no broken links
requirements.acceptance: automated internal-link check passes on the combined tree
requirements.note: runs locally and in CI

requirements.requirement: Reproducible: deterministic builder, data in version control
requirements.acceptance: two consecutive builds produce identical bytes
requirements.note: VER-09 checks it

requirements.requirement: Betting/reward legality in the owner's jurisdiction
requirements.acceptance: not attempted; would require a verified legal source
requirements.note: guessed regulator page returned 404 - recorded as unverified rather than asserted

requirements.requirement: Historical backtest dataset (prices, results, injury history)
requirements.acceptance: not available; the archive starts now via S-05
requirements.note: the single largest dependency in the project

requirements.requirement: Verification log per line with pass/fail and method
requirements.acceptance: every published statistic traceable to a check that was actually run
requirements.note: 16 checks

requirements.requirement: Flagged-for-review page, published and non-blocking
requirements.acceptance: labelled page with source links so changes can be requested after the site is live
